senses.gloss: (Pilp. of בוץ or בצץ; v. בְּצָא) to break through, bubble forth, burst forth.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11b">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>היו מְבַצְבְּצִין וכ׳</he> they burst forth and came out of the ground.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> the righteous (dead) <he>שמבצבצין וכ׳</he> will break through (the ground) and rise in Jerusalem.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 13a:11">Pes. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>היה חמץ מב׳</he> the leavened bread crumbled through the bag.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite>, end; <cite ref="Gittin 56b:9">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>דם מב׳ ויוצא</he> blood bubbled forth.
<cite ref="Chullin 56a:3">Ḥull. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אם מב׳</he> if the brains bubble through the hole in the scull.
